run_f_gold: run f_gold to count binary strings of length n without consecutive 1s
test_f_gold: test f_gold against expected results for various input values of n
summarize_f_gold: summarize the dynamic programming approach f_gold uses to count valid binary strings
review_f_gold: review f_gold to understand the recurrence relation for counting binary strings without consecutive 1s
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use O(1) space instead of O(n) arrays
